notes: Read session_orchestrator together with continuation_policy and SessionArtifactStore. Session-visible phase is surfaced through task_progress; kernel PhaseManager remains the phase SSOT and is bridged through canonical turn history and checkpoint state, not role-profile schema. Role capability invocation is latest-only: mounted ports validate role allow-lists, capability fingerprints, and command contracts, then delegate to target Cell public APIs such as runtime.task_market PublishTaskWorkItemCommandV1, chief_engineer.blueprint GenerateTaskBlueprintCommandV1, factory.verification_guard VerifyCompletionCommandV1, finops.budget_guard ReserveBudgetCommandV1, and policy.workspace_guard WorkspaceWriteGuardQueryV1. Architect boundary validation uses policy.permission EvaluatePermissionCommandV1, policy.workspace_guard WorkspaceWriteGuardQueryV1, and architect.design GenerateArchitectureDesignCommandV1 through public services; sandbox denials return allowed=false.
